notes.title: Visual Novel Fest 2025 (3 Mar - 10 Mar, 2025)
notes.content:
Hey, friends! Our games are part of the Visual Novel Fest sale running from March 3rd to March 10th, 2025, with [b]big discounts![/b] Here’s a quick look at what you can grab:  
[list]
[*] [b]Stories of Submission: Learn Your Place[/b] – William’s life falls apart, but meeting Mistress Freya gives him a new start as her servant. A story about finding yourself through obedience.  

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45109603/5c1bdba3c8ddc91fa62c36d64d645a40ae1d5323.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1355370/Stories_of_Submission_Learn_Your_Place/


[*] [b]Stories of Submission: eNTeR the cuck[/b] – A year into serving Freya, William hears Alex and Stacy’s tale, exploring complicated relationships and what it means to submit. This novel features heavy NTR kinks.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45109603/af7116a2a5d25cb819d8cc8e5e7e2ddcacc49ffb.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1576590/Stories_of_Submission_eNTeR_the_cuck/


[*] [b]Furry Femmes: Making an Obedient Bitch[/b] – Follow Mike and Kara as they dive into genetic experiments, leading to wild transformations and a battle for control. It’s a mix of love, science, and submission.  

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45109603/d6349e26a5840e3a8289863dca2e726fc36f49c7.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2083060/Furry_Femmes_Making_an_Obedient_Bitch/
[/list]
These titles are on sale at prices too good to pass up, so don’t miss your chance to get in on the fun! Hurry to the store and grab them before March 10th, 2025.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Durak NTR Update: Hint System to Improve Your Durak Experience!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45109603/4fff7035aff3a7712efee9076f426839b11d82a4.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2664370/Durak_NTR_the_Fool_who_lost_his_gf_in_a_card_game/

We’ve been listening to your feedback, and we know that some players—especially those new to Durak—wanted a little extra help getting into the game. So, we’re introducing a brand-new [b]Hint System![/b]

Now, you’ll notice a [b]lightbulb button[/b] at the bottom of the game screen. When activated, it will [b]highlight the cards you can play[/b], making it easier to learn the mechanics and keep the game flowing smoothly. Whether you’re just getting started or stuck in a tricky situation, this feature is here to help!

We hope this makes your experience even better. As always, we appreciate your feedback—keep it coming, and let us know what you think!

See you at the table!

notes.title: 🎭 A Fresh Update for Our Netorare Visual Novel Fans! 🎭
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1576590/Stories_of_Submission_eNTeR_the_cuck/

We’re thrilled to announce that our beloved visual novel, crafted for the most passionate netorare enthusiasts, has just received a significant upgrade!

✨ What’s New?

 • Revisited Texts: Enjoy an enhanced narrative experience with refined dialogue and deeper storytelling.
 • French Localization: [b]Bonjour, mes amis! [/b]The game is now fully localized in French, bringing our captivating tale to an even wider audience.

Whether you’re a longtime fan or new to the genre, now’s the perfect time to dive into this provocative story. Experience the emotional highs and lows like never before!

[b]Merci pour votre soutien[/b], and enjoy the ride!
